source.description: Who made the changes: the API key's name, which is usually the integration's, or the assignor calendar's (FEED-8).

changes.description: What happened, most important first; added and removed come alone.

title.description: Home v Away, or the match's name.

kickoff.description: When it kicks off now (or did, for a removed match).

previousKickoff.description: With kickoff: when it was going to.

timeZone.description: IANA time zone name, for example America/Los_Angeles.

venue.description: Where it is now: the venue, and pitch.

previousVenue.description: With venue: where it was going to be.

description: What an integration (an API key, or an assignor calendar) did to the user's matches, collected over about a minute, for a phone to write as a notification (NOTE-3).
